widgets_values: The image is a vertical realistic photograph of a young woman in her twenties standing beside a tall window in a quiet apartment, pale cream walls and a loose dusty-rose linen curtain behind her. The background falls away in shallow focus, with a sliver of beige plaster wall filling the upper-left corner, a blurred row of three small potted plants along a white windowsill at the right edge, and the dark frame of an open door just visible in the lower-right. She stands a little left of centre, her weight on her back foot, shoulders angled slightly toward the camera, chin lowered. Her gaze drifts down and to the right, past the lens, and her expression stays calm and unposed, lips barely parted, no smile. Her hair is long and dark brown with a soft wave, falling forward over her right shoulder and tucked behind her left ear, three or four strands lifting free across her jaw. Her skin is fair with a faint warm undertone, and the window light planes across her right cheekbone, leaving the left side of her face in a gentle falloff. She wears an oversized off-white cotton shirt with the collar open and the sleeves pushed up to her elbows, the fabric creased at the shoulder seam and softened by wear, layered over a pale grey ribbed knit camisole that shows at the neckline. In the upper part of her chest a thin gold chain sits flat against her collarbone. Her left hand rests on the edge of the window frame, fingers relaxed and slightly curled, and her right hand catches the cuff of the opposite sleeve near her hip. At the bottom of the frame the shirt hem meets a pair of soft grey lounge trousers, only their top edge visible. A cup of tea, glossy ceramic and half full, sits on the sill behind her left shoulder. The lighting is soft diffused daylight entering from the window on the left, wrapping her face and the front of the shirt, with a faint bounce off the white sill filling the shadow side and no hard edges anywhere in the frame. The overall composition is airy and asymmetric, using generous negative space in the upper-left, a restrained palette of cream, dusty rose and off-white, and a quiet, unhurried domestic mood.
